motion: AI agents should be regulated by an international oversight body

propose.content: International oversight establishes enforceable safety benchmarks, cross-border auditability, and shared incident reporting for autonomous AI agents because frontier model risks transcend national borders.

oppose.content: A centralized international body slows iterative innovation, lags behind rapid technical change, and creates regulatory capture risks; therefore, agile national standards are preferable.

propose.content: Transparent weights allow independent researchers to audit vulnerabilities, reproduce red-team findings, and patch systemic flaws faster than closed-source vendors.
